notice_title.text: Post-Graduate Merit Scholarship 2026-27 Renewal & Verification Notice
notice_title.evidence_quote: Sub: Post-Graduate Merit Scholarship 2026-27 Renewal & Verification Notice

issuing_organisation.text: State Higher Education Directorate, Scholarship Cell
issuing_organisation.evidence_quote: ISSUED BY: State Higher Education Directorate, Scholarship Cell

affected_party.text: All registered awardees under PG Merit Scheme 2025-27
affected_party.evidence_quote: Target Beneficiaries: All registered awardees under PG Merit Scheme 2025-27

main_purpose.text: Submit semester renewal dossiers and attendance verification online before disbursement suspension
main_purpose.evidence_quote: All eligible scholars are hereby instructed to submit semester renewal dossiers online on or before 15-11-2026 to avoid disbursement suspension.

plain_language_summary.what_is_this: This is a mandatory renewal notification for students receiving the Post-Graduate Merit Scholarship.
plain_language_summary.why_it_matters: Scholars who do not renew on time will face immediate suspension and eventual forfeiture of their monthly stipends.
plain_language_summary.what_to_do: Obtain your 75% attendance certificate, gather your Semester II marksheet, and submit renewal forms online.
plain_language_summary.where_to_do_it: Upload documents exclusively through the state scholarship portal at https://scholarships.state.gov.in.
plain_language_summary.if_deadline_missed: Failure to submit by 15-11-2026 results in forfeiture of scholarship disbursements for subsequent academic quarters.

deadlines.description: Last date for online submission of renewal dossier on the state scholarship portal.
deadlines.evidence_quote: last date for online upload on the state scholarship portal is 15-11-2026 up to 5:00 PM IST

deadlines.description: College Principal countersignature verification window (relative deadline).
deadlines.evidence_quote: Principals must countersign uploaded forms within 7 working days from portal closing
deadlines.ambiguity_reason: Relative institutional deadline 'within 7 working days from portal closing' without explicit calendar date.

required_documents.name: Semester II Official Marksheet
required_documents.evidence_quote: Self-attested copy of Semester II Official Marksheet is mandatory

required_documents.name: Minimum 75% Attendance Certificate
required_documents.evidence_quote: Institution head signed certificate certifying minimum 75% attendance

required_documents.name: Hostel Fee Receipt
required_documents.evidence_quote: Hostel residents may attach fee receipt for consideration of additional accommodation stipend (optional)

submission_channel.evidence_quote: Submissions will be accepted exclusively via state portal https://scholarships.state.gov.in

penalties.description: Disbursement suspension and forfeiture of scholarship for subsequent quarters
penalties.evidence_quote: Failure to submit by stipulated date shall result in forfeiture of scholarship for subsequent quarters.

action_steps.action: Obtain signed attendance certificate from Head of Department certifying minimum 75% attendance.
action_steps.evidence_quote: Step 1: Obtain signed attendance certificate from Head of Department.

action_steps.action: Log in to portal https://scholarships.state.gov.in and click Renewal 2026.
action_steps.evidence_quote: Step 2: Log in to portal https://scholarships.state.gov.in and click Renewal 2026.

action_steps.action: Upload PDF copies of Semester II marksheet and attendance certificate.
action_steps.evidence_quote: Step 3: Upload PDF copies of Semester II marksheet and attendance certificate.

action_steps.action: Submit physical printout of submitted acknowledgment to College Nodal Officer.
action_steps.evidence_quote: Step 4: Submit physical printout of submitted acknowledgment to College Nodal Officer.

warnings.warning_text: Students with attendance below 75% are ineligible for renewal without special board exemption.
warnings.evidence_quote: Institution head signed certificate certifying minimum 75% attendance
